scores.notes: Left Watson is stocky with dark brown hair and a heavy moustache; the right image has two candidates, a slim sandy-haired man being pulled in by Holmes (does not match) and a stocky dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag in the doorway (matches), so the subject is not singled out.
Holmes in both is a gaunt clean-shaven man with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead, hawk nose and hollow cheeks in a black frock coat; faces match closely.

Both are night scenes in flat English countryside with hedges and trees and a house fire throwing up smoke; left sees it as a distant blaze from the station, right close up from the drive, which is compatible, though left shows little of the house itself.

Watson left (standing, arms crossed) and right (lying on the bed shielding his eyes) both have brown side-parted hair, a brown moustache, ruddy face and solid build in shirt sleeves and waistcoat; the right face is partly covered by his arm but hair and moustache match.

Left Holmes (the tall man at the door pulling Watson in) is markedly balding with a bare crown and thin dark hair at the sides; right Holmes (tossing the paper ball) has a full head of slicked-back dark hair with a widow's peak, so the hairline conflicts though both are gaunt and clean-shaven.

Left Watson (on the bed shielding his eyes) has dark brown hair and a dark moustache; the right image has two candidates, a slim sandy-haired man being pulled in by Holmes (does not match) and a stocky dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag in the doorway (matches), so the subject is not singled out.

Both show a white-walled two-storey country house with a red tiled roof and tall chimneys burning at night, horse-drawn red fire engines on the grass in front, hedges and bare trees around and flat fields beyond; the roofline is drawn wider on the left but the place is compatible.
Watson has a brown moustache, sturdy build and ruddy face in both; left he is small and hatted in the street, right close up in a waistcoat, with no conflicting cue.

Left Holmes (pulling Watson in at the door) is a youngish man with a full mop of tousled dark hair falling over his forehead; right Holmes is a much older, lined, gaunt man with a receding swept-back hairline.

Holmes is lean, clean-shaven and pale with dark swept-back hair and a high forehead in both; the left face is more gaunt and shadowed by matchlight, the right is in profile, but hair, build and age agree.
Holmes is a gaunt, lined, clean-shaven middle-aged man with dark hair swept back from a receding hairline and a sharp nose in both, in profile left and three-quarter right.

Both are night scenes of flat hedged English farmland with a large blaze throwing orange-lit smoke above a clump of trees; left stands in the grounds before the white house, right sees the same fire from the station platform with the house hidden by trees. Nothing conflicts.

Left Holmes (at the door pulling Watson in) is a youngish man with a full head of tousled dark hair over his forehead; right Holmes is an older, lined, gaunt man with greying hair swept back from receding temples. Hairline and apparent age conflict.

The left image has two candidates for Watson: the sandy-haired moustached man in a brown suit being pulled in by the arm, and a sturdier dark-moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag. The second matches the right-hand Watson (bowler, dark moustache, dark coat, bag) and the first does not, so the description does not single out one figure.

Left Holmes (striking with the cane) has a full head of dark slicked-back hair over a gaunt face; right Holmes (at the door, far right) is markedly bald on top with only side hair and a rounder, softer skull, a clear hair/hairline conflict.

Watson (in bowler with bag on the left; arms folded by the fire on the right) is a fair-skinned, sturdy man with a full brown moustache and clean chin in both; the right face is a little more lined and the moustache slightly more auburn, but no clear identity cue conflicts.

Taking left Watson as the man Holmes pulls in by the arm (brown suit, light-brown hair, brown moustache, clean chin), he matches the seated right Watson (brown suit, brown hair and moustache, similar age and build). Note the left image also has a second Watson-like man in a bowler with a medical bag; he too is moustached and brown-haired, so neither reading conflicts.
Watson (seated right in the carriage; standing with folded arms by the fire) has the same brown hair, thick reddish-brown moustache, clean chin, ruddy middle-aged face and solid build in both.

Watson (on the bed shading his eyes on the left; seated at right in the carriage) has the same brown hair, thick brown moustache, clean chin, fair skin and medium-sturdy build in both; the left figure is smaller with a hand at his brow but hair and moustache are clear.

Left Holmes (foreground with pipe and lens) is a gaunt, lined middle-aged man with straight dark slicked-back hair and a high receding forehead; right Holmes (pulling the man in at the door) is a visibly younger smooth-faced man with a thick tousled mop of dark curly hair over his forehead. Hair style, hairline and age conflict.

The right shows the house itself (white two-storey house with chimneys ablaze, lawn, hedges, lane, fire engines) at night in flat farmland. The left is set at the railway station and shows the fire only as a distant glow and smoke column over flat hedged fields at night; nothing conflicts, but the house and its grounds are not visible there, so the place cannot really be compared.

Left Holmes (pulling the moustached man through the door) is a youthful man with tousled curly dark hair over the forehead and a fuller face; right Holmes in the armchair is an older gaunt man with slicked-back hair, widow's peak and hollow cheeks.

Watson standing with arms crossed (left) is burly with a broad heavy-jowled ruddy face and a thick walrus moustache; Watson seated in the carriage (right) is slim with a narrow face and a small neat moustache. Hair colour matches but build and face shape conflict.
Holmes with steepled fingers in the armchair (left) and raising the cane (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, hollow-cheeked with slicked-back dark hair and a widow's peak, similar middle age.
Holmes examining the hat with a lens (left) and striking at the bell-rope with a cane (right): both lean, clean-shaven, hawk-nosed with dark swept-back hair and a high forehead, similar middle age.

Holmes with pipe outside the shopfront (left, small) and raising the cane with a lit match (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, hollow-cheeked with slicked-back dark hair and widow's peak, tall thin build.
Left Holmes is a gaunt older man with slicked-back receding dark hair and hollow cheeks; right Holmes is noticeably younger with a thick wavy fringe falling forward and a fuller face.

Left shows the burning white house close up with rose bushes and fire engines at night; right is the station platform at night with only a fire glow and smoke behind a clump of trees, so the house and grounds are not visible to compare.

Watson at left is small, in a bowler, with a reddish-brown moustache and ruddy face; at right he has reddish-brown hair and the same full moustache in profile. He looks a little stouter at left but hair colour, moustache and age agree.
Holmes is a lean, clean-shaven man with dark swept-back receding hair, hawk nose and gaunt cheeks in both (left in profile by the bell-rope, right seated in the armchair).

Left Holmes (throwing the paper ball) has straight slicked-back receding hair and a gaunt middle-aged hawkish face; right Holmes (dark coat, pulling Watson in) has a thick tousled curly mop and a younger, fuller face.
Left Holmes (raising the cane) has thin slicked-back receding hair and a gaunt hollow-cheeked older face; right Holmes (with the magnifier) has thick wavy full hair and a younger, fuller face.

Watson (left seated on the right bench, right in the bowler with the doctor's bag) is a solid middle-aged man with brown hair and a full brown moustache, otherwise clean-shaven, in both; the right moustache is a little more waxed but nothing conflicts.

Holmes in both is a lean, clean-shaven man with dark swept-back hair, high forehead, hollow cheeks and a sharp aquiline nose (left throwing the paper ball, right with the magnifier); right looks slightly older but features match.

Both show a brick-vaulted cellar with a flagstone floor and stacked wooden crates leading to a dark arched opening; left adds barrels and more arches, and the darker right is the lantern-screened moment the descriptions ask for.

Both show a brick barrel-vaulted cellar with a flagstone floor, stacked wooden crates along the walls and a dark arched passage at the far end, lit by a lantern; the right shows more side arches from another angle.

Watson is the moustached man in the bowler with the doctor's bag on the left and the moustached man lying on the bed on the right; brown moustache, age and build match, though his arm covers his eyes on the right.

Holmes (reaching for the paper ball on the left, in the armchair on the right) is a lean clean-shaven man with dark swept-back hair and a sharp nose in both; he looks somewhat younger and less gaunt on the left but no cue clearly conflicts.
Holmes on the left (studying the hat with a lens) has a full head of thick dark wavy hair, while the man at the door on the right is bald on top with only side hair and a much gaunter, older face.

Watson (in the bowler with the bag on the street, sitting up in bed shading his eyes on the right) has the same brown hair, thick brown moustache, middle age and stocky build, though he is small in both.
